model.name: BUG: terminal keyboard-bar SILENT-EMPTY — when keys.length was 0 the bar rendered NOTHING, so absent-by-DEFECT was indistinguishable from absent-by-DESIGN (vacuity)
model.description: Tron-facing DEFECT (real page): RbTerminalDetail.mountKeyBar, on a 0-length keymap (keys.length === 0), rendered NOTHING and returned silently — so a keyboard-bar that was absent BY DEFECT looked identical to one absent BY DESIGN. This is the vacuity class killed everywhere else this campaign (an empty container that looks fine = the same lie as a gate that passes without asserting). FIX (expert v0.8.91, dcf921a00): the 0-keys case now FAILS-CLOSED AND VISIBLE — it renders a role=status notice NAMING the cause, so an absent bar is never a silent mystery. DISTINCT from R40.3 (OS-keyboard SUPPRESS) and R40.20 (keybar first-key TOGGLE) — those are features whose deliverability depends on the bar being legible about its own state.
model.correctionRecord: ★ DIAGNOSIS CORRECTED (honest history, not a quiet edit): this unit was FIRST minted (b16fad62e) on a READ-PATH-MISMATCH hypothesis (reader used j.model.keys instead of j.unit.model.keys) — that hypothesis was MEASURED FALSE by the expert: the read-path has read j.unit.model.keys FIRST (with j.model.keys/j.keys fallbacks + Array.isArray guard) since R40.3 v0.8.67 (241ce4683), still present at rb-terminal-detail.ts:92. An AC describing a non-existent mismatch would be trivially 'satisfied' = a FALSE RECORD on disk (the exact thing we refuse). The hypothesis was relayed unmeasured (PO relayed the tester's framing); corrected here to the REAL measured defect = SILENT-EMPTY. Same uuid kept; ACs rewritten; correction recorded so the unit's history is honest.
model.openResidual: ★ SEPARATE OPEN QUESTION (do NOT fold into this unit): /api/ior serves 8 keys, so the NORMAL path SHOULD render 8. IF the tester at @390 still sees NO bar with 8 keys actually served, that is a DISTINCT render/CSS/WebKit defect in renderKeyMap (dbdcc42d), NOT the silent-empty vacuity — it gets its OWN unit. This unit covers the 0-keys silent-empty case ONLY.

discoverySource.note: Real defect = silent-empty (0-keys renders nothing). The read-path hypothesis relayed with it was measured false (see correctionRecord). Evidence = r403a gate.
discoverySource.evidence: test/visual/r403a-terminal-suppress-layout-gate.mjs — asserts .rb-keybar renders + keys reach the PTY @390 real-WebKit. The 0-keys case (was silent-nothing, now role=status notice) is the vacuity the fix makes visible.

model.crossRefNote: DISTINCT from R40.3 (terminal OS-keyboard SUPPRESS, gate r403a) and R40.20 (keybar first-key TOGGLE, design-req). Not folded — different features. crossRef listed as impacted context. Fix shipped v0.8.91 (dcf921a00).

acceptanceCriteria.text: When the keymap is empty (keys.length === 0), mountKeyBar MUST NOT render nothing silently — a keyboard-bar absent BY DEFECT must be distinguishable from one absent BY DESIGN (the vacuity lie: empty-that-looks-fine).

The 0-keys case FAILS-CLOSED AND VISIBLE: it renders a role=status notice NAMING the cause (why there are no keys), rather than an empty/absent region — so the state is legible to Tron on his device (expert fix v0.8.91).
On the normal path (/api/ior serves N>0 keys), the bar renders the N keys as before — the fail-visible notice is ONLY for the genuine 0-keys case, never a regression of the populated bar.

GATE (r403a, DET-3x @390 real-WebKit): 0 keys → assert a VISIBLE role=status notice (not an empty region); N keys → assert the .rb-keybar renders the N keys + a key's bytes reach the (mocked) PTY. Chromium-emulation NOT accepted for the render half.
